summary.text: Amos Quick is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 58 in Guilford County since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists him as House Democratic Whip and as pastor of Friendship Baptist Church in Lexington, North Carolina.

paragraphs.text: Amos Quick assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2017, succeeding Chris Sgro (D).
The General Assembly lists five terms in the House for Quick, along with his leadership role as House Democratic Whip.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
